thread:
naomi_r: Heads-up — DSAR from EU user wants full erasure (embeddings + chat). Legal placed a short investigatory hold (HLD-9001). Need a minimal custody-proof flow; do NOT delete while hold active. @legal-team
legal-team: Hold HLD-9001 created. Please prepare signed proof artifacts and chain-of-custody logs.
kevin_c: Short plan: 1) freeze writes for user 2) export snapshot list 3) create a short-lived ephemeral HSM key 4) create a timebound custodian role for ops 5) rewrap snapshot -> verify -> produce proof.json 6) upload proof to priv-proofs and attach audit.
ops-oncall: I can run this. Approvers? Keep IAM minimal (cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on ephemeral key only).
keystore-admin: Approvers: @kevin_c + @naomi_r. I will not grant keystore-owner. I'll help with key creation if needed.
ops-oncall: Running commands now (preview):
```
keystore list --user U555 > preop-list.txt
# create ephemeral key
gcloud kms keys create ephemeral-hld-9001 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rg
# bind minimal IAM
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-hld-9001 --member=serviceAccount:ops-oncall@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
# rewrap and verify
keystore rewrap --snapshot=snap-eu-9001 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-hld-9001 --ephemeral-ttl=1h
keystore verify --snapshot=snap-eu-9001 --proof-out=hld-9001-proof.json
aws s3 cp hld-9001-proof.json s3://priv-proofs/HLD-9001/
```
ops-oncall: Grant created, expires in 1h. Audit entry: https://audit.internal/entries/hld-9001-grant :lock:
ops-oncall: Rewrap + verify completed, proof uploaded to s3://priv-proofs/HLD-9001/ :white_check_mark:
naomi_r: Verified proof, shared with Legal. Marked snapshot metadata `hold:HLD-9001`. No deletion performed.
legal-team: Received artifacts. Hold remains; will update when cleared.
keystore-admin: Note: orphaned snapshot detected (snap-orphan-9001) referencing missing key version. Logged fallback: admin-assisted unwrap is available but requires explicit approval and additional audit trail.
kevin_c: Follow-up actions: add runbook item to automate timebound custodian role creation, signed-proof schema (key fingerprint, KMS version, signer), and orphan-snapshot playbook.
sec-bot: Vault: HLD-9001 artifacts and audit logs saved.
